title: pi-agent MCP configuration
description: Explicit trusted direct MCP servers. Runtime validation additionally checks UTF-8 byte budgets, URL authority, reserved headers and project trust.

$schema.description: Editor schema reference; ignored by the runtime and never fetched.

mcpServers.description: Named servers; no process or connection is restored from journal authority.

enabled.description: Connect the server when explicitly selected by the host.

exposure.description: Required for enabled servers. Deferred and codemode exposure are unsupported.

type.description: Subprocess transport; the default when command is present.

cwd.description: Working directory relative to host cwd, not the configuration file.

env.description: Explicit whole-value environment references; literal secrets are rejected.

type.description: Streamable HTTP transport; OAuth and legacy SSE are unsupported.

url.description: Endpoint without credentials, query or fragment.

headers.description: Distinct non-protocol header names mapped to whole-value environment references.
